description: US-003 requires the test suite to assert all five 1.1.0 stamps and pass, but US-005 owns those version changes and depends on US-003, so US-003 is not independently satisfiable in declared dependency order.
evidence: stories-outline.md:62-87 assigns the five-stamp assertion and passing test to US-003; stories-outline.md:119-145 assigns the actual manifest and marketplace bumps to US-005 while declaring dependencies on US-003 and US-004.
recommendedFix: Reorder the metadata story before the exact-version gate, merge US-003 and US-005, or move the 1.1.0 assertions and final full-suite pass into US-005 so each story can pass in dependency order.
resolution: US-003 now checks five-stamp consistency at the current version; US-005 owns the final 1.1.0 expectation, all five bumps, and the post-bump full-suite pass.

description: The plan requires byte-for-byte comparisons against authored .txt fixtures but does not define an LF checkout contract for those files, allowing CRLF conversion to break otherwise correct snapshots.
evidence: plan.md:150-154, 199-202, and 324-326 require .txt fixtures and raw byte-exact checks. At commit 964c36f, ai-developer-toolkit/.gitattributes has no rule covering plugins/subagent-model-routing/tests/fixtures/*.txt.
recommendedFix: Add plugins/subagent-model-routing/tests/fixtures/*.txt text eol=lf to the root .gitattributes file list and acceptance criteria, or use an authored fixture format whose bytes are not checkout-converted; do not hide drift by normalizing during comparison.
resolution: The plan and US-003 now include plugins/subagent-model-routing/tests/fixtures/*.txt text eol=lf and explicitly forbid comparison-time line-ending normalization.

description: The plan acknowledges that the generic release skill is incompatible with this two-manifest plugin but leaves the exact-reference root release instructions unchanged, so shipped documentation would still direct maintainers to a nonexistent Claude manifest and a four-file release path.
evidence: plan.md:63-67, 183-192, and 500-502 exclude the global release guidance from modification. At commit 964c36f, ai-developer-toolkit/AGENTS.md:60 mandates a .claude-plugin/plugin.json bump and AGENTS.md:69 says to use the four-file release skill for plugin releases.
recommendedFix: Without changing the generic skill implementation, add a narrow root AGENTS.md exception for subagent-model-routing that documents the manual five-stamp path, the absence of a Claude manifest, and that the incompatible release skill must not be used; include it in US-004/US-005.
resolution: The root AGENTS.md scope now includes a narrow manual five-stamp exception and explicitly forbids using the incompatible generic release skill for this plugin.
